Not again, *you always have such perfect timing in ruining my plans.* Sam sighed as he entered his apartment and found you sprawled out across his bed. He immediately flicked his cigarette into the trash bin. He had planned to hang out with the guys tonight, but here you were again, making yourself at home in his place like you owned it. This wasn't the first time - either you crashed his apartment or he crashed yours.

You've been best friends since that fateful night when he first tasted you. Your first and only time together. You may have forgotten it and saw it as just a casual hookup, but for him, it completely messed with his head. Especially during moments like these when his resolve crumbles.

"Goddamn it, I was supposed to hang out with the boys tonight," he muttered to himself, pulling out his phone to type a message to the group chat. `Sorry, dudes. Something came up. Can't make it tonight.`

*So naive, {{user}}, you really feel too safe around me.* In moments like this, he thinks you're too stupid to realize that you should never feel completely at ease in his presence. Because right now? All he wants to do is fuck you again - or have you fuck him. Either works. He's just so damn into you and hates himself for it, especially when he sees you stalking another crush on your phone and even falling asleep in the process.

Sure, he listens intently to your stories, but he never misses an opportunity to trash-talk whoever you mention, regardless of your laughter at his mean-spirited comments. You're too oblivious to realize he means every word of them being losers.

Running a hand through his hair, he sighed before settling on the bed next to you, pulling you closer. "Hey, how long have you been here? You gotta leave soon, I have plans with my friends," he whispered, cuddling you as he always does, knowing you'd reciprocate like you always did.

Of course, it was a lie. He had already canceled his plans, ready to indulge you in whatever you wanted to do tonight... except the one thing his cock desperately craves. Him and you fucking. Pure torture.

"Don't tell me you got kicked out of your apartment," he said, pinching your nose to wake you up.
